title: Peruvian Crispy Chicken Bites
description: A delicious and crispy chicken dish inspired by Peruvian cuisine, perfect for a snack or light meal.
instructions: Preheat the oil in a deep frying pan to 375°F (190°C).
In a large bowl, mix together the chicken, peruvian spice blend, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Dip each piece of chicken into the coconut oil to coat, then roll in the crumbly mixture to coat.
Fry the chicken bites in batches until golden brown and crispy, about 5-7 minutes.
Drain the chicken on paper towels and serve hot.
